property_structure.description: Not fully accurate to its name; remains from when materials were still used. Marked as deprecated in the code but still used extensively.

requires_shears.property_description: Whether this block has a different drop when using shears

blast_resistance.property_description: Determines how likely the block is to break from exposure to an explosion.

block_entity.property_description: Whether this block has an associated block entity, and whether it's ticking or non-ticking.

solid.property_description:
Not fully accurate to its name; remains from when materials were still used.
Marked as deprecated in the code but still used extensively.

requires_silk_touch.property_name: Different Drop When Using Silk Touch
requires_silk_touch.property_description: Whether this block has a different drop when using a silk touch enchanted tool

xp_dropped_when_mined.property_description: The amount of experience points this block drops upon mining.

translation_key.property_description: The untranslated key used to fetch the name of the block from language mappings.

bottom_face_has_small_square.property_description: This is true if the bottom face contains a square of length 2 at its center.

connects_to_walls.property_description: Whether a wall block to the north will connect to this block.

iron_golem_spawnable_on.property_description: Whether iron golems can spawn on this block.

raid_spawnable.property_description: Whether raids can spawn on this block.

burn_odds.property_description: The higher the burn odds, the quicker a block burns away (when on fire). 0 means it is non-flammable.

height_all.property_description:
The block's upwards-facing collision surfaces.
Includes internal collisions.
Defaults to pixel values, this can be converted in the settings.

top_face_has_small_square.property_description: This is true if the top face contains a square of length 2 at its center.

top_face_has_collision.property_description: This is true if the top side has collision at the outer face (meaning it has a hard hitbox that aligns with the block grid).

top_face_has_rim.property_description: This is true if the top face contains a 2 pixel wide ring going around its edge

supports_redstone_dust.property_description: Whether redstone dust ("wire") can be placed on top of this block.

movable.property_description: Whether the block can be pushed by a piston, stops the piston from extending, or whether attempting to push it destroys the block.

opacity.property_description: How much light the block dampens

bottom_face_has_collision.property_description: This is true if the bottom side has collision at the outer face (meaning it has a hard hitbox that aligns with the block grid).

emits_power.property_description: Whether this block can emit redstone signals.

ignite_odds.property_description: The higher the ignite odds, the more likely a block is to catch fire (if it is able to spread there).

translated_name.property_description: The translated name of the block, if it exists, i think.

spawnable.property_description: Whether mobs can spawn on this block.

requires_correct_tool.property_description: Whether using the required tool is needed for this block to drop as an item.

flammable.property_description: Whether the block can be destroyed by fire.

luminance.property_description: How much light the block emits.

connects_to_panes.property_description: Whether a glass pane block to the north will connect to this block.

fluid_render_type.property_description: Which fluid render type the block uses.

gets_flushed3.property_description: Whether this block will get destroyed by flowing water or lava.

gets_flushed2.property_description: Whether this block will get destroyed by flowing water or lava.

gets_flushed1.property_description: Whether this block will get destroyed by flowing water or lava.

instrument.property_description: Which instrument a note block will play if placed above this block. This does not include mob heads.

side_face_has_full_square.property_description: This is true if the north face has a full, square surface.

blocks_beacon_beam.property_description: Whether placing this block above a beacon will prevent its beam from forming, or stop its current one.

water_forms_source_above.property_description:
Whether water can form a source above this block.
If infinite lava is on, it will form sources above the same blocks, but above lava and not above water.

conductive.property_description: Whether or not a redstone component can be powered through this block.

comparator_output.property_description: Whether interactions with this block sends updates to comparators up to 2 blocks away (manhattan distance).

bottom_face_has_full_square.property_description: This is true if the bottom face is a full square.

generates_in_structures.property_description: Based off of what blocks show up in the standard structure palletes. Does not include all complex structures.

wither_block_break_immune.property_description: Whether this block is immune to the wither's block breaking attack.

waterloggable.property_description: Whether this block can be waterlogged.

kills_grass.property_description: Whether grass will die when placed underneath this block.

hardness.property_description: Determines how fast the block can be mined.

map_color.property_description: The color of this block when viewed on a map. NONE is transparent, meaning it is simply ignored. Note that waterlogged blocks will have the map color of water.

sticky.property_description:
Whether the block can be pulled by a sticky piston or an adjacent slime/honey block.
Slime and honey are listed as 'partially' as they are not sticky when pulled by one another.

gets_random_ticked.property_description: Whether the block gets affected by random ticks.

width_all.property_description:
The block's sideways-facing collision surfaces.
Includes internal collisions.
Defaults to pixel values, this can be converted in the settings.

suffocates_mobs.property_description: Whether a mob or player should suffocate in this block.

liquid.property_description:
Not fully accurate to its name; remains from when materials were still used.
Marked as deprecated in the code but still used extensively.

collision_bottom_all.property_description:
The block's downwards-facing collision surfaces.
Includes internal collisions.
Defaults to pixel values, this can be converted in the settings.

dragon_immune.property_description: Whether this block is immune to The Ender Dragon flying through it.

side_face_has_collision.property_description: This is true if the north side has collision at the outer face (meaning it has a hard hitbox that aligns with the block grid).

blocks_motion.property_description:
Not fully accurate to its name; remains from when materials were still used.
Marked as deprecated in the code but still used extensively.

replaceable.property_description: Determines whether a block placed or falling on this block will replace it rather than being placed against or on it.

wither_skull_immune.property_description: Whether this block is immune to the wither's skull attack.

obstructs_cactus.property_description: Whether placing this block next to cactus destroys it.

block_render_type.property_description: Which block render type the block uses.

top_face_has_full_square.property_description: This is true if the top face is a full square.

has_collision.property_description: Whether the block has any solid collision box.

intended_tool.property_description: The intended tool(s) used to destroy this block faster

exists_as_item.property_description: Whether this block has a direct item equivalent.

opaque.property_description: Whether the block is visually opaque.

full_cube.property_description: Whether the block has a normal cube shape and has full block collision on all sides.

falling_block.property_description: Whether the block can fall when unsupported (as a falling_block entity).

ignited_by_lava.property_description: Whether lava can set this block on fire.

redirects_redstone.property_description: This is true if the North side connects to/redirects adjacent redstone dust.

sends_comparator_updates.property_description: Whether interactions with this block sends updates to comparators up to 2 blocks away (manhattan distance).

is_opaque_full_cube.property_description:
Whether the block is opaque and renders as a full cube. Note that this is not an AND of Opaque and Full Cube,
as this uses the rendering shape and Full Cube uses the collision shape.
